definitions.gloss: single parent; one parent; one of the two parents
definitions.explanation: A household with only one parent present, due to divorce, death, or other circumstances. Also used neutrally to mean "one of the two parents" when the other is being contrasted.

examples.japanese: {片親|かたおや}⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was raised in a single-parent household.

examples.japanese: {片親|かたおや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of children with one foreign parent is increasing.

examples.japanese: {片親|かたおや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くした→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I volunteer at an organization that supports children who have lost one parent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair) + ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parent). Compare {片足|かたあし} (one foot) for the same ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片親|かたおや}⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: single-parent household
- {片親|かたおや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up with one parent
- {片親|かたおや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くす→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧: to lose one parent

USAGE:
In sensitive contexts (welfare, news reports), ひとり⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ is now preferred over {片親|かたおや}, which can sound dated or carry slight stigma. {片親|かたおや} is still widely used in casual speech and when contrasting one parent with the other.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ひとり⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: single parent — modern, neutral term used in policy and media
- ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧: both parents — the contrasting form
